# About Lantern Supply Co.

Last updated: October 1, 2026
Owner: Priya Whitcomb-Nair

Lantern Supply Co. sells camping lanterns, oil lamps, fuel and parts from two showrooms in
Maryland and from the online store at lanternsupply.example. We make some of what we sell, we
repair everything we sell, and we have been doing both since 1987. This page is the short version
of who we are, for new employees and for customers who ask.

[2] employee-handbook.md > Other benefits
### Other benefits

Full-time employees receive a company-paid life insurance policy of $25,000, a pretax commuter
benefit of up to $150 a month, and an annual stipend of $200 for work boots or safety footwear for
warehouse and repair staff. The company pays for the ServSafe-style fuel handling certification
required for warehouse staff and renews it every three years.

[3] employee-handbook.md > Welcome
## Welcome

Lantern Supply Co. was founded in 1987 by Marjorie and Dale Whitcomb in Frederick, Maryland, and
is still owned and run by the family. Priya Whitcomb-Nair, the founders' daughter, has been chief
executive since 2019. As of October 2026 there are 63 of us across the Frederick headquarters and
showroom, the Annapolis showroom and the Hagerstown warehouse and Repair Center. We are a small
company that sells a small range of things well. Most of the people who buy from us are repeat
customers, and most of them know a great deal about lanterns. Treat them that way.

[4] lumen-rewards.md > Earning points
## Earning points

Members earn 1 point for every $1 spent on merchandise, calculated on the amount paid after
discounts and before shipping and tax. Fractions of a dollar are dropped: a $34.99 Firefly 220
earns 34 points, and a $219.99 Sentinel 1000 Pro earns 219 points. Gift card purchases earn no
points; purchases paid with a gift card earn points as usual.

Points post 48 hours after the order is delivered, or 48 hours after a showroom purchase. The
delay exists so that an order cancelled before delivery never shows points that then have to be
removed. Points from a showroom purchase post only if the member number was given at the
register; receipts can be added to an account within 30 days by calling customer service.

Points also come from:

- Writing a product review on the online store: 25 points per review, up to 100 points a year.
- The birthday reward, described below.
- Occasional double-points events, announced by email; the last was the week of
  September 14, 2026, which was double points on the Sentinel line.

Points do not come from shipping charges, tax, repair fees, gift cards, or purchases from other
retailers.
